summary: A member asks who pays for collection if the city bills every household instead of charging beverage buyers.
realLife: Campbell argued that higher refuse rates could reach older or lower-income residents and people who never bought soft drinks.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: proposed fee base and service rates.

turns.what: A shopper who rarely buys soda checks what the proposal costs at checkout.
turns.pulledBy: Collection is paid through a charge on beverage sales.
turns.writesBack: A household's cost depends on covered purchases.

turns.what: A resident who buys no soda still sees a waste charge on the household bill.
turns.pulledBy: The city raises a general service charge instead.
turns.writesBack: A resident who buys no covered drinks can still face a higher bill.
